sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 10 (check 9), Internal Quality Checks row 10 (check 9), Deterministic Checks rows 19, 37, 41 (check-no-literal-secrets, check-allow-internet, check-no-allow-internet-true)
evidence: task.toml [environment] (lines 20-24) reads exactly: 'build_timeout_sec = 600.0', 'network_mode = "public"', 'cpus = 2', 'memory_mb = 4096'. This is identical to the frozen template task.toml and to the staged-task-contract block; a diff of task.toml against the template shows only name, description, keywords, difficulty, difficulty_explanation, category, provenance and arena_slice changed. '[environment].docker_image' and 'allow_internet' do not occur anywhere in task.toml (grep: no match). No secret literal under [environment]; the only credential-shaped lines in the task are the frozen [verifier.env] template 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"' and 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""' (a ${VAR} template and an empty string, both expected by the profile and owned by row 10). environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical (modulo line endings) to the template Dockerfile; its only ENV is 'ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules', it has no ARG, it copies only 'instructions/' and 'assets/' (no solution/ or tests/), and sets git identity to the placeholder 'turing@local.invalid'. A case-insensitive scan of task/environment, task.toml and instruction.md for api key, secret, token, password, bearer, sk-, AKIA, PEM, ghp_ and xox patterns found only the two [verifier.env] lines above and the word 'tokens' in instructions/ui.md:13 (syntax tokens). assets/seed_data.json is 149 bytes with an empty 'snippets' array and no credentials. Sanity of resources: the image preinstalls express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 globally; the reference app (solution/app/package.json) is a single Node/Express + SQLite server with a Vite/React front end, a workload that 2 CPUs and 4096 MB accommodate, and the scripted golden run indexed in raw-evidence-index.json was installed and launched in this agent image. Counter-checks tried: (a) a broken configuration that could slip through - docker_image set, allow_internet present, a provider key in ENV/ARG or seed data - none is present; (b) a conforming alternative that could be wrongly failed - public network and build/solve-time fetching - is explicitly correct under the profile and is not flagged. The Internal Quality Checks annotation for this row still says 'no-network ... nothing that secretly needs an install'; the public Quality Checks row, SKILL.md delivery profile and the assignment all state network is public, so the internal wording is superseded and creates no finding. Limitation (note, not a waiver): the agent image build was not re-run by me and the scripted golden results were produced on the previous commit's bytes, which differ only in judge prompt.md files, not in task.toml or environment/; resource adequacy for the hosted agent phase is therefore inferred from configuration and the scripted run, not measured by a configured run on these bytes. That gap is runtime evidence owned by the workload rows and does not change this row's static verdict.
